title: How Claude Code is redefining what one developer can build alone

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if one developer could now build entire systems alone, thanks to tools like Claude Code?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Claude Code enables end-to-end coding, from design to deployment, using natural language and AI-driven synthesis.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this risks eroding collaborative skills and deepening inequality if access to such tools is uneven.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source integration and community-driven training help ensure broader participation and shared knowledge.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where solo developers democratize innovation, bridging gaps in tech access and expertise.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about what we can build—it’s about who gets to build it.

video_cue: A single developer typing on a keyboard, with lines of code forming into a fully functional app interface in real time.
